A 'Zootopia 2' logo and instructional text are overlaid on the screen in the upper left corner. (2) The woman begins playing the recorder, moving her fingers over the instrument's holes with precision. Her gaze is fixed directly on the camera, maintaining a neutral but focused expression. Digital overlays displaying musical fingering numbers and letters appear and change in real-time above a scrolling musical staff at the bottom. The lighting is bright and even across the scene, clearly illuminating her face and hands. (3) She concludes the short musical performance, holding the final note while maintaining her posture. She gives a very slight, pleasant smile toward the viewer as the phrase ends. The environmental setting remains consistent throughout the take, with no camera movement or cuts, emphasizing her performance and the educational text overlays which remain visible until the end.
